scope: Small/medium real-model CPU arrays; not large-scale or GPU performance
timing_conditions: Warm cache; one warmup; shuffled six-format rounds. Ablations sequential.
limitations: Python raw/HDF5 frontends and native C loading have different overheads
Same-codec HDF5 uses Python orchestration around the identical C block decoder
No separate RSS, disk-cold, GPU, layout-conversion or solver-setup measurement
Conversion includes parsing/encoding/writing; it is not source-reader-only timing
Stored sizes count metadata and checksums; raw baselines include a JSON manifest

baselines.scope: CPU arrays only; no layout conversion, solver setup or solve
baselines.cache: Warm: one unmeasured load per format; shuffled measurement rounds; no cache flush
limitations: Python/HDF5 vs C reader overhead differs
Whole-file buffers; no separate RSS measurement
Baseline manifest metadata is cached; OptBin rereads its directory
Encoded HDF5 uses the same C codecs, with Python frontend overhead
gzip level 1 and Zstd level 1 are different codecs
